what: The small devnet batch of decision G-19: the grant and the revoke that imd-flop session grant and session revoke print, signed by the lab's owner key through the research signer, between the lab's own accounts on FLOP devnet, with test tokens. Four owner transactions at most, and the cleanup tries of a revoke. No FLOP moves to any device. U2, the expiry's edge, is not in this batch.

A_DAILY_FLOP.how: A_DAILY as FLOP text, for cap set

A_PER_TX_FLOP.how: A_PER_TX as FLOP text, for cap set --per-call

SESSION_COUNT_STOP.decided: B-5: P0 stops when SessionCount(S) is 9 or more or cannot be read

SESSION_COUNT_KEY.type: u32, Default (metadata default 0): the same report's storage table, FlopSessionKeys.SessionCount

ROTATION_HISTORY_KEY.type: kept raw in the record, not judged

DAYS.decided: one epoch: the tool's shortest grant, and the length the research signer signs after H2

SPENDING_CAP.how: imd-flop/src/session/caps.ts grantCaps: spending_cap = raw(daily cap) times days

DURATION.how: imd-flop/src/session/caps.ts grantCaps: duration_blocks = SessionEpochLength times days

FEE_GRANT.how: the rerun's A2 and the encoder test's T2: a create_session of one allowed name, ComputeChannel, of the same length as G1's (the u32 duration has a fixed width)

FEE_REVOKE.how: the rerun's A10 and the encoder test's T8: revoke_session

MAX_FEE.how: the most per step (B-10): the rerun's A3, the largest fee the lab has recorded for one owner or session call

FENCE.decided: B-10: the 0.15 FLOP of standing word A, the most this batch may cost in the worst case

SEAT.decided: B-6: the seat home of this batch is the tool's own word for a seat with no token, inside the tool's seat grammar (imd-flop/src/keys.ts isSeatId). It names no seat NFT, so no line of the record can be read as a claim about a real seat; the device it holds is a research device that signs nothing and holds nothing

PROBE_BACK.decided: H7: the block of the free read of Core_version is about 1000 below the finalized head

STORED_RECORD_LINE.value: Whether the chain takes a new grant over a stored record for this owner and device is not shown yet.

seat.why: B-3: the holder's real path, init then cap set then session grant. The device key file stays in the seat home on the PC and is never read by a script of this folder; the device's account comes from identity.json did.

send_outcomes_from.why: H11: every owner step of this batch is immortal; the rows are imported, not written again

steps.reads: lab.accountReads of the owner (the runtime, the genesis, the transaction version, the head, the owner's next nonce); one session tape at one finalized head, with SessionCount(S) and RotationHistory(S) beside it; the free read of Core_version at an old block (H7); then the tool's session show over the tape
steps.expect: the runtime, the genesis and the transaction version are the plan's; SessionCount(S) is below $SESSION_COUNT_STOP; the pair is absent; show exits 0

steps.before: a session tape at a head at or above the last finalized step; the tool's session grant over it, exit 0, with no stored record
a session tape after G1; the tool's session revoke over it, exit 0
a session tape after R1; the tool's session grant over it, exit 0, printed with the stored record line
steps.u1: taken: SessionCreated as G1, then R2. refused with FlopSessionKeys.$ALREADY_EXISTS: the end. another error: recorded, U1 stays open, the end
steps.fee_refused: unknown: no failed create_session is recorded in any committed file; bounded by $MAX_FEE

steps.before: a session tape after G2; the tool's session revoke over it, exit 0
